situation.headline: Trump orders major US-Israel coordinated strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure this weekend, triggering Iranian drone attacks on Kuwait, tanker strikes in Hormuz, and a credible escalation toward regional war that directly threatens global oil supply and US force protection across the Middle East

domains.name: Middle East
domains.label: regional escalation 90d
domains.status: US-Israel strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure are either imminent or already underway, Iran is retaliating with tanker strikes in Hormuz and drone attacks on Kuwait, and Russia is actively providing Iran ISR and EW support against US munitions, creating a multi-vector escalation spiral with no visible off-ramp.

domains.name: Indo-Pacific
domains.label: China coercion escalation
domains.status: China is intensifying legal and military pressure over Scarborough Shoal and Philippine baseline claims while US attention and carrier assets are consumed by Middle East operations, raising Beijing's window of opportunity for gray-zone coercion.

domains.name: Europe
domains.label: NATO cohesion fracture
domains.status: Ukraine's air defense depletion is severe with only two Patriots fired during a major Russian missile strike including six Zircon hypersonics, suggesting collapse of coverage is near, while Spain's enclave crisis with migrant surges is straining southern-flank EU solidarity.

domains.name: Energy
domains.label: supply shock 60d
domains.status: Six Saudi tankers have already rerouted around Africa to avoid Bab al-Mandab, a tanker has been hit in Hormuz with engine room damage leaving it adrift, and Iranian threats to strike regional energy infrastructure in retaliation for US strikes signal imminent supply disruption of potentially historic scale.

domains.name: US Politics
domains.label: House flip Nov 2026
domains.status: Trump approval at 32 percent with a new low of 12 percent among Black voters and 23 percent among Latinos, combined with Texas alarm signals and MAGA media fracturing, point toward significant Republican midterm vulnerability, consistent with Ossoff market surge and prediction-market pricing.

situation.unseen: Russia's active provision of satellite and signals intelligence to Iran against US aircraft and munitions is the most underappreciated cross-domain threat: it effectively makes this a US-Russia-Iran trilateral confrontation, not a bilateral US-Iran one, and creates a direct precedent for Russian ISR support against US forces that could be exported to any future theater including Taiwan; simultaneously, the AI-fabricated satellite imagery capability announced by Google Earth creates an immediate disinformation risk for battle damage assessment of Iranian strikes and US counterstrike effects, poisoning the intelligence picture at the exact moment clarity is most critical.
situation.criticalWindow: The next 72 to 96 hours encompass the opening of US-Israel strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure, Iranian retaliatory escalation decisions including potential closure or mining of the Strait of Hormuz, and Kuwait's active air defense engagement of Iranian drones, any one of which could trigger Article 5 consultations, oil price spikes above historical shock thresholds, or Iranian strikes on US bases that force a further escalation decision before diplomatic channels can be established.
watchFor: Iran announcing closure or mining of the Strait of Hormuz or Bab al-Mandab, which would be the single most economically catastrophic escalation signal
Additional US military assets or carrier strike groups ordered to the Persian Gulf region, indicating preparation for sustained campaign rather than limited strikes
China conducting military exercises near Taiwan or Philippine-claimed features during the US Middle East distraction window, exploiting reduced US Pacific posture
Russian-provided jamming or ISR causing a US aircraft or munition loss attributable to Russian support, which would force a direct US-Russia escalation decision
situation.confidenceNote: All strike timing and coordination details derive from OSINT and media reports without verified primary sourcing; the distinction between an imminent strike, a strike already in progress, and strategic leak intended to pressure Iran into negotiations is impossible to resolve from available context; Iranian retaliatory capacity and willingness to close Hormuz remains uncertain; Trump approval polling and market predictions reflect a single moment with high variance in midterm projections three months out; Russia ISR support claim is attributed to anonymous US and European officials and cannot be independently confirmed.
situation.topPattern: The convergence of US-Israel energy strikes on Iran, Russian ISR support to Iranian forces, tanker attacks in Hormuz, Kuwaiti air defense activations, and Saudi tanker rerouting around Africa constitutes a de facto multi-party war on global energy chokepoints; prediction markets have not yet priced this risk into domestic US economic contracts, suggesting either a lag in integration or a collective assessment that escalation will remain contained, a bet that the Hormuz tanker strike and Iranian tank movements toward the Kuwaiti border now put in serious question.

signals.headline: Trump Orders Major Iran Bombing Campaign; Strikes on Energy Infrastructure Coordinated with Israel Starting This Weekend
signals.summary: Multiple sources (WSJ, CNN, CBS) confirm Trump has ordered a large-scale bombing campaign against Iranian energy infrastructure in coordination with Israel, potentially beginning this weekend and lasting several days. U.S. embassies across the Middle East have issued security alerts. Iranian military is moving tanks toward Iraqi/Kuwaiti borders and has struck tankers in Hormuz; Russia is providing Iran satellite and signals intelligence.
signals.signal: Imminent kinetic escalation risks regional war, disruption of global energy markets, Iranian retaliation against U.S. forces/allies, and potential cyber/proxy attacks on U.S. infrastructure. Intelligence sharing between Russia and Iran complicates air-defense calculus. Domestic political cost to Trump if strikes fail or trigger broader conflict.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that Trump administration prefers diplomatic off-ramps; market pricing shows minimal escalation-event hedging.

signals.headline: Iran Threatens Retaliatory Strikes on Middle East Energy Infrastructure if U.S. Strikes Iranian Targets
signals.summary: Senior Iranian security official told Tasnim that Iranian forces will target energy infrastructure in the Middle East if U.S. conducts strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure. Tankers already being struck in Strait of Hormuz; Saudi tankers routing around Africa to avoid Bab al-Mandab.
signals.signal: Threat of tit-for-tat energy infrastructure attacks could create supply-chain shocks, spike oil prices, and destabilize Gulf shipping. Saudi Arabia and UAE may face direct Iranian targeting, forcing U.S. to defend allies with troops/air cover. Economic spillover to U.S. inflation and election-year politics.
signals.contradicts: Market complacency on energy-security tail risks; oil futures show modest repricing only.

signals.headline: Trump Approval Falls to Historic Low (32% Overall, 12% Among Black Voters, 23% Among Latino Voters)
signals.summary: New polling shows Trump approval at 32% overall, with particularly weak support among Black (12%) and Latino (23%) voters. Concurrent headlines show ICE arrests of nanny of MAGA voter, labor disruptions in airports/nursing homes due to deportations of Haitian workers, and hardening Republican primary dynamics.
signals.signal: Erosion of Trump base among minorities threatens 2028 general-election viability and may constrain congressional Republican support for major foreign-policy escalation. Immigration enforcement domestically is generating visible political backlash that could weaken consensus for war footing.
signals.contradicts: Notion that Trump retains unified GOP coalition for military action; prediction markets show tepid enthusiasm for Trump 2028 presidency (3%).

signals.headline: China Escalates South China Sea Pressure; PLA Stages Drills, Rejects Philippine Baseline Claims, Patrols Huangyan Dao
signals.summary: China military, coast guard, and civilian patrol assets are conducting operations near Huangyan Dao (Second Thomas Shoal) and rejecting Philippine maritime delimitation claims. PLA staged drills days after Philippines' territorial baseline filing. Escalation mirrors U.S. distraction by Iran crisis.
signals.signal: China using window of U.S. Iran-focused posture to solidify control of contested shoals and erode Philippine/allied position. Risk of accidental collision between PLA and Philippine/U.S. assets. Tests Trump administration's ability to manage multiple theaters simultaneously.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that China will remain passive during U.S. Middle East escalation; GDELT volume suggests coordinated messaging campaign.

signals.headline: Todd Blanche Attorney General Nomination Facing Loyalty-Credibility Trade-Off; Market Pricing Declines 2¢ in 24h
signals.summary: Todd Blanche's AG nomination is at 63% on prediction markets (down 2¢ in 24h). Headlines reference 'Loyalty Proves Double-Edged Sword' and internal MAGA fractures. Fauci diary leaks and broader media-ecosystem fragmentation suggest erosion of Trump brand loyalty.
signals.signal: Weak confirmation likelihood for key Cabinet position could delay DOJ continuity during foreign-policy crisis. Nomination instability signals deeper factional discord in Trump coalition at moment when unified executive command is operationally critical.
signals.contradicts: Narrative of Trump consolidating power; internal tensions visible in betting and media.

signals.headline: Google Suspends AI Image Generation in Google Earth Rollout After Backlash; Deepfake and Satellite-Image Manipulation Risks Escalate
signals.summary: Google announced suspension of AI Earth image generation feature amid concerns from experts on potential abuse. Follows reporting on fabrication risks and misuse vectors. Signals broader tension between AI capability and information-security risk.
signals.signal: Adversaries (Russia, China, Iran) will weaponize AI-generated geospatial disinformation to confuse U.S. intelligence collection and undermine credibility of satellite intelligence during Middle East crisis. Increases reliance on human intel and allied reporting, which may be compromised.
signals.contradicts: Optimistic framing of AI as force-multiplier for U.S. defense; critical infrastructure and targeting verification now at heightened epistemic risk.

scanNote: Signal quality is high; OSINT feeds and market moves corroborate major escalation trajectory, but domestic political weakness and allied/adversary maneuvers are underpriced by mainstream consensus.

markets.label: Trump invokes Insurrection Act before Jan 20 2029
markets.rationale: With Trump at 32% approval, ongoing immigration enforcement chaos displacing essential workers, and Democrats wargaming troops at voting locations, the political pressure to invoke the Act is building but not yet determinative.

markets.label: Trump invokes Insurrection Act before 2027
markets.rationale: Near-term invocation remains unlikely given current political bandwidth consumed by the Iran escalation and immigration enforcement; market at 23% appears slightly overpriced relative to near-term probability.

markets.label: Todd Blanche as next Attorney General
markets.rationale: Drudge flags loyalty as a double-edged sword for the AG nominee and the withdrawal market saw a sharp 10-cent drop, suggesting increased but not dominant uncertainty around Blanche's confirmation.

markets.label: Blanche nomination withdrawn before Aug 5 2026
markets.rationale: The 10-cent drop in withdrawal probability and Drudge's 'loyalty double-edged sword' framing suggest scrutiny is rising but withdrawal within days remains unlikely given limited time window.

markets.label: Greenland becomes 51st US state before Jan 20 2029
markets.rationale: No actionable movement in OSINT or market signals; the Greenland no-acquisition contract priced at 82% confirms the market sees annexation as a near-dead scenario within this term.

markets.label: No US acquisition of Greenland during Trump term
markets.rationale: Zero OSINT indicators of imminent Greenland negotiation progress and the Middle East crisis is consuming all US geopolitical bandwidth, making acquisition in this term overwhelmingly unlikely.

markets.label: Jon Ossoff as 2028 Democratic nominee
markets.rationale: Drudge flags Ossoff receiving a massive boost in a key race, elevating his profile at a moment when Democrats are actively searching for viable alternatives to Harris; market at 15% is reasonable but slightly underpriced given the positive momentum signal.

markets.label: AOC as 2028 Democratic nominee
markets.rationale: AOC's 2-cent drop in a low-volume session suggests mild fading; Trump's low approval and Democratic energy typically favor progressive insurgents but AOC faces structural electability concerns that cap her realistic ceiling.

markets.label: Marco Rubio wins 2028 presidential election
markets.rationale: Rubio leads Republican general election prospects at 18% on Kalshi but Trump's 32% approval drags the entire Republican brand; a successful Iran campaign could partially rehabilitate GOP standing, making this highly contingent on near-term military outcomes.

markets.label: Lee Zeldin as next Attorney General
markets.rationale: Zeldin saw a 2-cent uptick suggesting marginal interest as a Blanche alternative, consistent with the broader uncertainty flagged in Drudge, but remains a distant second to Blanche at 63%.

groundTruth.headline: Trump has ordered major bombing campaign on Iranian energy infrastructure coordinated with Israel, strikes possible this weekend lasting days
groundTruth.summary: Multiple OSINT sources (CBS, WSJ, conflict_radar feeds) confirm Trump military order for strikes on Iranian energy targets. US embassies issued security alerts; Saudi tankers already rerouting around Africa. This represents deliberate strategic escalation with direct presidential approval.
groundTruth.signal: If executed, will trigger immediate regional instability, Iranian retaliation cycle, potential Strait of Hormuz closure, global energy shock, and major test of US force coordination with Israel under combat conditions.

groundTruth.headline: Iran actively striking tankers in Strait of Hormuz and has pre-positioned forces; Russia providing real-time ISR and jamming support
groundTruth.summary: UKMTO confirms projectile strikes on tankers (engine room hits); Iranian T-72s repositioned toward Iraqi/Kuwaiti borders; US intelligence assesses Russia feeding satellite and signals intelligence to Iran for targeting and electronic warfare. Kuwaiti air defenses actively engaging Iranian drones.
groundTruth.signal: Indicates Iran prepared for immediate kinetic response; Russian involvement raises risk of unintended US-Russia escalation and validates Iranian claim of external support, strengthening Tehran's narrative with regional allies.

groundTruth.headline: Trump approval at 32% with 12% among Black voters and 23% among Latino voters; prediction markets price his 2028 general election win at only 3%
groundTruth.summary: Drudge tracking poll data shows historic low approval; racial demographic splits suggest alienation beyond traditional Republican base. Prediction market pricing (3% Trump, 18% Vance, 18% Rubio for 2028 general) indicates severe confidence deficit despite Trump holding executive power.
groundTruth.signal: Suggests war-time rally effect not materializing; sustained low approval during military escalation signals domestic political vulnerability; potential constraint on Trump ability to sustain prolonged conflict without bipartisan support or major tactical success narrative.

groundTruth.headline: ICE enforcement targeting mixed-status households; airports, nursing homes, schools bracing for worker disruption; MAGA voters experiencing unintended consequences
groundTruth.summary: Drudge reports Haitian worker shortage at critical infrastructure; headline documents MAGA voter whose nanny was arrested. No Kalshi market yet on labor disruption, but real-time economic friction emerging between enforcement rhetoric and operational reality.
groundTruth.signal: Creates domestic political vulnerability on multiple fronts (health care, elder care, agriculture); signals Trump administration prioritizing enforcement identity over economic impact mitigation; could trigger business/Republican defections if service disruptions mount before 2026 midterms.

groundTruth.headline: Todd Blanche at 63% in next AG market with recent 2-cent decline; loyalty concerns raised regarding nominee track record
groundTruth.summary: Prediction market shows Blanche leading but momentum weakening; Drudge headline flags 'Loyalty Proves Double-Edged Sword' suggesting Senate/media resistance to pure Trump loyalist. Lee Zeldin gaining 2 cents to 9%, indicating market hedging.
groundTruth.signal: AG selection will govern prosecution strategy, J6 cases, and DOJ independence during wartime; market declining confidence in Blanche confirmation suggests either GOP Senate reluctance or emerging vetting issues that could derail approval before August.
